id./param/scenario/cs/b_080_cs_100.pack|cs_: "King Carnelian, Lord Robert. It's about time to start the Colloquy of Kings. Please prepare.
"I heard from Robert. Your son, {var:1}, is the Luminary reborn.
"I intend to present my son to everyone at the Colloquy.
"Being blessed by so many people, I felt it anew. The Luminary is our light of hope...
"...I'll hear it later. I'll go to the meeting room first.
"The Luminary holds the fate of Erdrea, so everyone has their thoughts...
"Well, Irwin, it's time. Go to Eleanor's room and fetch {var:1}."
